climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Pinot Gris sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A Côte de Beaune appellation for red wine from Pinot Noir and white from Chardonnay, with slightly over 85 percent red. It has no grand cru vineyards.
